governance_registration.required_update_policy: Any change to COMPLIANCE-001 governed surfaces, local validation authority, or claim boundaries must update this contract and its reachability registry entries in the same PR.

_meta.purpose: Machine-readable governed-surface and claim-boundary contract for the COMPLIANCE-001 schema/fixture/local-validator review slice. This spec keeps operative surface accounting out of rationale-only ADR prose.

can_claim_now: The compliance-pack schema records optional COMPLIANCE-001 contract fields for signature verification, SOC2-style evidence collectors, cell certification state, CMP consent, and portability export metadata.
Synthetic fixtures demonstrate SOC2/CMP/portability export shapes for local validation.
The owned-Rust/Buck2 contract-slice-conformance gate (compliance-001-pack-schema slice) checks the compliance-pack schema's required fields, enums, and claim-boundary wording.
cannot_claim_yet: SOC 2 certification or auditor acceptance exists
runtime evidence collectors, CMP deployment, or portability export jobs/APIs exist
a tenant can activate this pack in production
DSR SLA, regulator submission, or production launch readiness is satisfied

governed_surfaces.authority: owned-Rust/Buck2 contract-slice-conformance gate policy entries (compliance-001-pack-schema, compliance-001-contract-spec, compliance-001-pack-fixture, compliance-001-portability-manifest-fixture slices)
